column6: The Raspberry Pi 4 Module B SC0193(9) single board computer features a powerful Broadcom BCM2711 ARM Cortex-A72 quad-core processor running at 1.5GHz, making it an excellent choice for a variety of embedded computing applications. With 2GB of RAM and a compact size of 85.00mm x 56.00mm, it offers performance in a small form factor. This SBC includes 40 digital I/O lines, Gigabit Ethernet, multiple USB ports (two USB 2.0 and two USB 3.0), and supports video outputs via CSI, DSI, and HDMI interfaces.
